technical.summary: Short-term momentum is bullish with RSI9 rising and three white soldiers pattern, but price remains below key moving averages (50/200) and Ichimoku cloud, creating conflicting intermediate-term signals in a neutral sector environment.

fundamental.summary: SWK shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 23 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (27/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no senior conviction, and absent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (360.8), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings in 23 days create a severely adverse macro backdrop for SWK.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI9 bullish momentum with three white soldiers pattern and supertrend confirmation offers short-term entry signal, amplified by extreme fear-zone contrarian opportunity (VIX 360.8).
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below 50/200 moving averages and Ichimoku cloud with earnings risk in 23 days, zero fundamental conviction, crisis macro backdrop (VIX, rising dollar, flat yield curve), and overbought stochastic/Williams %R create high probability of reversal into headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term RSI9 and three white soldiers momentum offer tactical entry, but price remains structurally trapped below 50/200 MAs with earnings risk 23 days out creating asymmetric downside.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 23 days combined with crisis macro backdrop (VIX 360.8, rising dollar, flat yield curve) and price below all key moving averages creates high probability of gap-down reversal.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
